summary: Skratch announces his upcoming visit to the Dragonheir developer studios in China for the game's third anniversary celebration. The studio invitation reveals upcoming anniversary content, including the Fate Divination faction war event where players choose between Chaos and Order. Other featured events include the Trial of the Child of Chaos, the Trial of The Dark Lady involving Magic Chess, and a developer Q&A session. A new redemption code was shared granting three Heliolite Dice to prepare for upcoming banners such as Child of Chaos.
meta_changes: Upcoming Fate Divination faction war event arriving with the anniversary, featuring a choice between Chaos and Order.
tips: Save Heliolite Dice for upcoming special banners, including the Child of Chaos banner.
title: Sagomir Invited Me To The Dragonheir Studio For Their 3rd Anniversary & We Have a New Promo Code
